test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option in which the words share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of words.

Freezer : Chill
solution:
**Logic : First word is an electric appliance whereas the second word tells us about its use.**

• Freezer : Chill

⇒ Freezers are usually kept in the kitchen which keeps food frozen at extremely low temperatures. It is where you keep your ice cubes and ice creams.

Similarly, Geyser is usually installed in the bathroom as people need warm water during winter to take bath. They help us in quickly heat water.

Thus,** Geyser : Heat** shares the same relationship as that shared by the Freezer : Chill.

Hence,** 'option 1'** is the correct answer.
